description: A protein takes part in a curated Reactome biochemical reaction as an input, an output, or both. The edge does not distinguish these roles; catalysts, regulators and active units are excluded.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting the relationship; Reactome for this type.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which this relationship was last seen.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was last created or updated in SPOKE.

source_contributions.scope: Biochemical reactions in the human BioPAX export within Signaling Pathways (R-HSA-162582), Immune System (R-HSA-168256), and Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers (R-HSA-5663202), including their descendant pathways. Only proteins with a UniProt reference matching an existing SPOKE Protein are represented. Protein sets are not expanded into member participation.
source_contributions.description: Protein participation is represented at the base UniProt accession: isoforms, modification states and cellular compartments share the same Protein endpoint. A protein appearing on both reaction sides has a single participation relationship. Isoform accessions are retained when supplied by Reactome.

properties.name: reactome_isoform_accessions
properties.description: UniProt isoform accessions of the protein instances participating in this reaction.
properties.notes: `UniProtKB:`-prefixed, de-duplicated, e.g. `["UniProtKB:P15692-4"]`; union across all slots resolving to the edge (both reaction sides, multiple components). Omitted when every contributing instance referenced a base accession.
